# teams_enhanced_encryption_policy (Resource)

Manages the EnhancedEncryptionPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsEnhancedEncryptionPolicy / Get-CsTeamsEnhancedEncryptionPolicy / Set-CsTeamsEnhancedEncryptionPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsEnhancedEncryptionPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `calling_endto_end_encryption_enabled_type` (String) Maps to the -CallingEndtoEndEncryptionEnabledType parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `meeting_end_to_end_encryption` (String) Maps to the -MeetingEndToEndEncryption parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
